title: SP GDSC × JCYEL Sentosa
text: This event by Singapore Polytechnic's Google Developer Student Club and Jurong Central Youth Enriching Life was filled with team-building around Sentosa Island. My group took part in the Imbiah Trail and quiz challenges, and we ended the day with a sandcastle building activity and a prize presentation.

photo.alt: Volunteers on the beach at Sentosa
